description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Detective's Satchel.
When Detective's Satchel enters, it triggers, creating two Clue tokens.
If you've sacrificed an artifact this turn, activate Detective's Satchel's ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three artifact tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
